proofs.text: Write an anchor carrying a `> Source:` line and no `> Pinned:` line, run `propose` on it, and verify the result is an error whose text contains `no pin` and whose exit code is 2

rule_text: An anchor that names a source and carries no pin cannot be proposed: the run reports the missing pin and exits 2

tests.body:
def test_propose_needs_a_pin(workspace):
    _write(upstream.anchor_path(workspace.root, 'loose'),
           '# Anchor: loose

> Source: %s specs/no_eval.md

## Rules

'
           '- RULE-1: Something

## Proof

- PROOF-1 (RULE-1): Check it
'
           % workspace.anchor_repo)
    result = upstream.propose(workspace.root, 'loose')
    assert result['status'] == 'error'
    assert 'no pin' in result['error']
    assert upstream._exit_code(result) == 2
tests.name: test_propose_needs_a_pin
